A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same framework, and their supplied text, equations, figures, and tables are readable and matchable. However, v1 references an appendix and v3 references Appendices B and C, none of which are included in the supplied PDFs. Referenced hyperparameter studies, configurations, and detailed latency analyses therefore cannot be compared.

before.justification: v1 reports original nuScenes detection results in Table 1 and component and prior-quality ablations in Tables 2–4.

after.justification: v3 retains the nuScenes experiments and reports additional Argoverse 2 results in Table 2 and expanded prior-quality experiments in Tables 5–6.

M1.justification: The three-module pipeline, neighborhood selection, densification, and loss equations remain substantially unchanged. However, v1 explicitly describes a sigmoid SGDM gate, whereas v3 Figure 2 labels the corresponding operation Softmax. The accompanying prose does not establish whether this represents an algorithm change or a diagram correction, preventing a reliable method-change judgment.

E1.justification: v1 evaluates only nuScenes. v3 adds Argoverse 2 validation, extending evaluation to different cities, sensor arrangements, and object categories while retaining nuScenes. This substantially broadens the represented data and evaluation coverage.

E2.justification: The nuScenes Table 1 comparator roster is unchanged. v3 adds VoxelNeXt in the Argoverse 2 comparison alongside existing comparator families, and includes YOLO-X in the prior-source comparison. LION versus LION-Mamba and corrected BEVFusion citations do not establish additional methods.

E3.justification: v3 adds evaluation under Argoverse 2's stated validation mAP protocol and revises prior-test controls: v1's specified 10% false-positive/10% false-negative perturbation is absent, while random, full-image, and YOLO-X priors and module-by-prior configurations appear. Reported image resolution, backbone, frustum settings, and GPU setup remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The original component ablations are retained, but v3 substantially expands investigation of dependence on 2D priors. Tables 5–6 add random and full-image controls and distinguish responses of DAM, FEM, and the full model. Table 3 also adds component-level latency measurements. These provide new robustness and component-sensitivity evidence beyond v1's aggregate prior-quality test.

E5.justification: Neither supplied PDF reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or statistical significance tests. v3's statement that random priors do not significantly harm performance is not accompanied by a statistical procedure.

E6.justification: All nuScenes Table 1 values and original component-ablation scores are retained. v3 adds Argoverse 2 results, including 41.7 mAP versus GraphBEV's 41.1, new prior-conditioned results, and component latency overheads of 13 and 7 ms. Random and full-image priors yield 68.5/71.2 and 69.4/71.8 mAP/NDS. The 70.3/72.5 row now describes YOLO-X rather than v1's synthetic noisy priors, so it is not a same-condition performance comparison.

T1.justification: Equations 1–9 retain the same substantive definitions and loss formulations. Neither supplied PDF presents new theorems or proofs. Removing Algorithm 1 does not remove a distinct derivation: its smoothing procedure remains described in prose and equations.

C1.justification: The three-module contribution and nuScenes state-of-the-art claim remain. v3 extends the claimed validation of robustness and generalization to Argoverse 2, reporting 41.7 mAP. It also narrows the novelty assertion from being the first to use explicit 2D guidance before fusion to being among the first for local alignment calibration.

C2.justification: v1 primarily explains DAGF through denoising and boundary preservation. v3 additionally argues that DAGF reverses erroneous PGDC smoothing when priors are flawed and interprets random/full-image prior results as evidence of robustness. It also expands the interpretation of SGDM gating as spatial confidence estimation. These are focused new mechanism explanations.

D1.justification: v3 newly specifies the discrepancy threshold as 10% of raw pixel depth and focal-loss parameters as gamma 2.0 and alpha 0.25. These are disclosures, not demonstrated setting changes. Conversely, the explicit MMDetection3D implementation statement and standalone smoothing pseudocode disappear. Additional configurations and latency details are directed to appendices absent from the supplied file.

R1.justification: v3 adds references for VoxelNeXt and Argoverse 2. The introduction replaces ObjectFusion with TransFusion as a contrast to the proposed alignment strategy and softens the priority claim to among the first. The broader related-work taxonomy and most cited works remain unchanged.

P1.justification: The introduction undergoes substantial paragraph rewriting, and the SGDM explanation and ablation narrative are reorganized and expanded. v3 introduces numbered section headings, removes the standalone algorithm, shortens the conclusion, and expands author, affiliation, and acknowledgement material. These changes substantially revise the document's exposition beyond adding experiments.

P2.justification: Figure 1 changes from a projection-error photograph to a large multi-panel conceptual comparison, and Figures 2–3 are extensively redrawn with revised labels and legends. v3 adds Argoverse 2 and module-by-prior tables, introduces a latency column, and reformats existing tables and captions. Figure 4 largely redisplays the existing qualitative examples.

improvement.justification: v3 strengthens v1's single-dataset evidence through Argoverse 2 evaluation and adds useful tests exposing how individual modules respond to unreliable priors. Parameter disclosures and revised diagrams also improve inspectability. The net gain is qualified by missing referenced appendices, limited specification of the new random-prior tests, removal of the explicitly quantified corruption condition, and the unresolved sigmoid/softmax description.
